name: workboard
description: AI-native dashboard for managing work projects — GitHub/Jira/Google Docs aware, with an MCP server for coding agents.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,mcp -c blue,magenta "bun run --filter @workboard/web dev" "bun run --filter @workboard/mcp dev"
scripts.build: bun run --filter @workboard/core build && bun run --filter @workboard/mcp build && bun run --filter @workboard/web build
scripts.start: concurrently -n web,mcp -c blue,magenta "bun run --filter @workboard/web start" "bun run --filter @workboard/mcp start"
